   HOMŒOPATHIC MATERIA MEDICA

         by William BOERICKE, M.D.

          Presented by Médi-T



           RHUS GLABRA

         Smooth Sumach


Epistaxis and   occipital headache. Fetid flatus  .
        Ulceration of mouth.   Dreams of flying through the air   (  Sticta  ).   Profuse perspiration arising
        from debility   (  China  ). It is claimed that
        this remedy will so disinfect the bowels that the flatus and stools will be free from odor.
        It acts well in putrescent conditions with tendency to ulceration.



Mouth.--  Scurvy; nursing sore mouth (  Veronica  ).
        Aphthous stomatitis.



Relationship.--  Said to be antidotal to the action of Mercury,
        and has been employed in the treatment of secondary syphilis after mercurialization.



Dose.--  Tincture. Usually locally to soft, spongy gums,
        aphthæ, pharyngitis, etc. Internally, first potency.
